message.content: {"caption":"A time-stepped schematic of an agent using retrieved cases and memory to choose actions, receive rewards, and update its memory.","description":"The diagram shows a repeated sequence of decision steps, with the first two steps and a later step t drawn and ellipses marking omitted intermediate steps. At each step, s (state) is above c (a retrieved past case), a (action), and r (reward); M below denotes the memory or case bank, which stores past cases such as (state, action, reward). Subscripts identify the step. The legend assigns red arrows to Environment Dynamics and blue arrows to Agent Behaviour; the arrows themselves have no text labels. In the first step, red arrows go from s₀ to s₁ and r₀, and from a₀ to s₁ and r₀. Blue arrows go from s₀ to c₀, a₀, and M₁; from M₀ to c₀ and M₁; from c₀ to a₀; and from a₀ and r₀ to M₁. In the next shown step, red arrows go from s₁ toward the next state in the omitted sequence and to r₁, and from a₁ toward that next state and to r₁. Blue arrows go from s₁ to c₁, a₁, and the memory continuation; from M₁ to c₁ and the memory continuation; from c₁ to a₁; and from a₁ and r₁ to the memory continuation. At step t, red arrows go from sₜ and aₜ to rₜ; blue arrows go from sₜ to cₜ and aₜ, from Mₜ to cₜ, and from cₜ to aₜ. The progression of states and memory, and the repeated connections across omitted steps, indicate the ongoing decision and memory-update process.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
